articles.title: Learning disability register enrolment in young people in England: a cohort study using primary care data
articles.authors: Shah R, Horridge K, Saxena S, Hargreaves DS, Petersen I

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Learning disability registers in UK primary care support proactive care, but under-identification remains substantial. The 2019 NHS Long Term Plan introduced targets to increase enrolment.
abstract.textZh: 學習障礙在英國初級保健支持主動式護理中註冊，但識別不足的情況仍然很嚴重。2019年NHS長期計劃引入了提高入學率的目標。

abstract.label: AIM
abstract.text: To estimate prevalence and rates of new registration to learning disability registers among young people aged 14-24 years in England and examine changes following the introduction of national targets.
abstract.textZh: 估計英格蘭14-24歲年輕人中學習障礙登記的患病率和新登記率，並研究引入國家目標後的變化。

abstract.label: DESIGN AND SETTING
abstract.text: Population-based open cohort study using routinely collected primary care data from general practices in England contributing to the Clinical Practice Research Datalink Aurum database, 2015-2023.
abstract.textZh: 基於人羣的開放隊列研究，使用從英格蘭的一般實踐中定期收集的初級保健數據，有助於臨牀實踐研究數據鏈接Aurum數據庫， 2015-2023。

abstract.label: METHOD
abstract.text: Young people aged 14-24 years who had been registered ≥6 months were included. Annual rates of new registration per 10 000 person-years at risk (PYAR) and recorded prevalence were calculated, stratified by age, sex, region, and year.
abstract.textZh: 已登記≥ 6個月的14-24歲年輕人也包括在內。按年齡、性別、地區和年份分層計算每10,000人年新登記率（ PYAR ）和記錄患病率。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Between 2015 and 2023, 11 776 young people were first recorded on a learning disability register. Rates of new registration increased in 2020-2021 across ages and sexes, peaking at 15.8 per 10 000 PYAR in males aged 14-17 years and 8.4 per 10 000 in females before returning to pre-2019 levels by 2023. Recorded prevalence remained low overall (0.03-0.5%; 3.6-52.7 per 10 000) but increased among those aged 18-24 years, with eight-to-10-fold rises between 2015 and 2023. Prevalence was higher in males (rate ratios 1.7-1.8, 95% confidence interval = 1.6 to 1.9).
abstract.textZh: 在2015年至2023年期間，有11,776名年輕人首次登記在學習障礙登記冊上。2020-2021年，不同年齡和性別的新註冊率有所增加，在2023年之前恢復到2019年之前的水平之前， 14-17歲男性的新註冊率高達每10 000 PYAR 15.8 ，女性為每10 000 PYAR 8.4。記錄的總體患病率仍然很低（ 0.03-0.5 ％ ；每萬人3.6-52.7 ） ，但在18-24歲的人羣中增加， 2015年至2023年間增加了8至10倍。男性的患病率較高（比率比為1.7-1.8 ， 95%置信區間= 1.6-1.9 ）。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: National targets coincided with a temporary rise in enrolment, but identification remains below expected prevalence. Sustained policy focus and systematic identification and coding by practices are needed to ensure equitable access to preventive care during the transition to adulthood.
abstract.textZh: 國家目標與入學率暫時上升相吻合，但識別率仍低於預期流行率。需要持續的政策重點以及按實踐進行系統識別和編碼，以確保在向成年過渡期間公平獲得預防性護理。

articles.titleZh: 英格蘭年輕人的學習障礙登記入學率：使用初級保健數據的隊列研究

articles.title: Disparities in the uptake of learning disability annual health checks: a secondary analysis of primary care data
articles.authors: Sutherland D, Costello B, Chauhan U, Flynn S, Gray KM, Parsons J, Spencer R, Crawford H

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: People with intellectual disabilities (referred to as learning disabilities in the UK) face considerable health inequalities. One attempt to address these in England has been through incentivising general practices to complete annual health checks with people with a learning disability aged ≥14 years.
abstract.textZh: 智障人士（英國稱為學習障礙）面臨相當大的健康不平等。在英格蘭，解決這些問題的一個嘗試是通過激勵一般做法，對年齡大於或等於14歲的學習障礙者完成年度健康檢查。

abstract.label: AIM
abstract.text: To examine recent trends in learning disability registers and the uptake of learning disability annual health checks in England.
abstract.textZh: 檢查英格蘭學習障礙登記的近期趨勢和學習障礙年度健康檢查的採用情況。

abstract.label: DESIGN AND SETTING
abstract.text: Secondary analysis of publicly available general practice data.
abstract.textZh: 公開一般實踐資料的次要分析。

abstract.label: METHOD
abstract.text: NHS England data relating to the learning disabilities annual health check scheme from January 2022 to November 2025 were compiled and analysed.
abstract.textZh: 我們彙編並分析了英國國民保健署（ NHS ）在2022年1月至2025年11月期間與學習障礙年度健康檢查計劃相關的數據。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: The number of 14-17-year-olds and adults on learning disability registers increased during this period by 30.49% and 14.53%, respectively. The most recent estimates indicate that around 0.588% (n = 374 763/63 766 671) of patients are on learning disability registers, with approximately 0.526% (n = 355 102/63 654 156) aged ≥14 years and eligible for annual health checks. The uptake of annual health checks increased slightly from 68.08% (n = 15 940/23 414) to 71.58% (n = 19 217/26 846) among 14-17-year-olds, and from 79.07% (n = 226 701/286 714) to 80.71% (n = 248 449/307 827) among adults. Uptake was lowest in the South West and East of England, and highest in London, but was similar across deciles of patient deprivation and practice size.
abstract.textZh: 在此期間，學習障礙登記冊上的14-17歲和成人人數分別增加了30.49%和14.53%。最近的估計表明，約有0.588 ％ （ n = 374 763/63 766 671 ）的患者在學習障礙登記冊上，約有0.526 ％ （ n = 355 102/63 654 156 ）年齡≥ 14歲，有資格進行年度健康檢查。14-17歲兒童接受年度健康檢查的比例從68.08% （ n = 15 940/23 414 ）略微增加到71.58% （ n = 19 217/26 846 ） ，成年人從79.07% （ n = 226 701/286 714 ）增加到80.71% （ n = 248 449/307 827 ）。攝取量在英格蘭西南部和東部最低，在倫敦最高，但在患者剝奪和實踐規模方面相似。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: Ascertainment of people with a learning disability by primary care services appears to be improving but remains between one-third and one-quarter of prevalence estimates. The uptake of annual health checks among 14-17-year-olds continues to lag behind that of adults.
abstract.textZh: 初級護理服務對學習障礙人士的確定似乎正在改善，但仍在估計患病率的三分之一至四分之一之間。14-17歲的年度健康檢查率繼續落後於成年人。

articles.titleZh: 學習障礙年度健康檢查採用方面的差異：初級保健數據的次要分析

articles.title: Relationships of actual and expected levels of income with GP job satisfaction: repeated cross-sectional study
articles.authors: Walker B, Anderson M, Ganepola R, Hutchinson J, Gibson J, Urwin S, Checkland K, Sutton M

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Income is known to be a key driver of job satisfaction, especially when compared with expected income. The pertinence of this for GPs is not fully understood.
abstract.textZh: 眾所周知，收入是工作滿意度的關鍵驅動因素，尤其是與預期收入相比。這與全科醫生的相關性尚不完全清楚。

abstract.label: AIM
abstract.text: To examine whether GP job satisfaction and intentions to quit are affected by actual and expected levels of income.
abstract.textZh: 檢查全科醫生的工作滿意度和辭職意圖是否受到實際和預期收入水平的影響。

abstract.label: DESIGN & SETTING
abstract.text: Repeated cross-sectional study involving GPs in England. The authors analysed responses to four waves of the GP Worklife Survey (a survey of GPs in England), between 2015 and 2021.
abstract.textZh: 在英格蘭重複進行涉及全科醫生的橫斷面研究。作者分析了2015年至2021年間對四波全科醫生工作生活調查（英格蘭全科醫生調查）的回應。

abstract.label: METHOD
abstract.text: Linear regression models were used to examine the associations of actual income with 10 domains of job satisfaction and three aspects of intentions to quit, adjusted for potential confounders; responders' self-reported expected incomes were then added to these models. These analyses were repeated, stratifying by contract status and age.
abstract.textZh: 使用線性迴歸模型來檢查實際收入與10個工作滿意度領域和三個辭職意圖方面的關聯，並針對潛在的混雜因素進行調整；然後將回應者自我報告的預期收入添加到這些模型中。重複這些分析，按合約狀態和年齡分層。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Higher actual income had a statistically significant association with increased satisfaction across most job satisfaction domains except for 'Amount of variety in your job', 'Your colleagues and fellow workers', and 'Physical working conditions'. There was little evidence of a relationship between actual income and intentions to quit. Higher expected income, conditional on actual income, had a statistically significant association with reduced job satisfaction across all domains and increased intentions to quit. The relationship between expected income and intentions to work abroad in the next 5 years was stronger for GPs aged <40 years, and the relationship between actual income and job satisfaction was stronger for GP partners and for GPs aged >50 years.
abstract.textZh: 除了「您工作的多樣性」、「您的同事和同事」和「實際工作條件」之外，實際收入越高，大多數工作滿意度領域的滿意度就越高。實際收入與辭職意圖之間的關係幾乎沒有證據。以實際收入為條件的較高預期收入與所有領域的工作滿意度降低和辭職意向增加有著統計學上的顯著關聯。對於年齡< 40歲的全科醫生，未來5年預期收入與出國工作意願之間的關係更強，而對於全科醫生合作夥伴和年齡> 50歲的全科醫生，實際收入與工作滿意度之間的關係更強。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: Higher incomes were associated with higher job satisfaction, but lower than expected levels of income were important sources of dissatisfaction and intentions to quit.
abstract.textZh: 較高的收入與較高的工作滿意度有關，但低於預期的收入水平是不滿意和辭職意圖的重要來源。

articles.titleZh: 實際和預期收入水平與GP工作滿意度的關係：重複橫斷面研究

articles.title: Investigating the conditions in which women GPs thrive in general practice: a realist review
articles.authors: Abrams R, Williams V, Park S, Golder S, Goyal A, Whiley L, Jefferson L

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Women GPs experience higher rates of burnout, anxiety, depression, and slower career progression than men GPs. Women GPs are sought out by patients for specific conditions, which may increase consultation length. This can be a source of job satisfaction for some. However, it can also contribute to additional exhaustion and affects career progression, meaning women GPs are at higher risk of leaving the profession. There is an urgent need to identify solutions to retain and support them.
abstract.textZh: 與男性全科醫生相比，女性全科醫生的職業倦怠、焦慮、抑鬱和職業發展緩慢率更高。患者會針對特定情況尋求女性全科醫生，這可能會增加會診時間。對某些人來說，這可能是工作滿意度的來源。然而，它也可能導致額外的疲憊並影響職業發展，這意味著女性全科醫生離開職業的風險更高。迫切需要確定留住和支持他們的解決方案。

abstract.label: AIM
abstract.text: This review brings together a wide range of evidence to identify the conditions in which women GPs can thrive, to better support them at work.
abstract.textZh: 這項審查匯集了廣泛的證據，以確定女性全科醫生可以茁壯成長的條件，以便在工作中更好地支持她們。

abstract.label: DESIGN AND SETTING
abstract.text: An international realist review of academic and grey literature was conducted across eight databases and Google Scholar.
abstract.textZh: 在八個資料庫和Google學術搜尋中，對學術文獻和灰色文獻進行了國際現實主義審查。

abstract.label: METHOD
abstract.text: Following a realist approach, supported by stakeholder and patient involvement, a range of published documents were analysed using a realist logic to identify how, why, for whom, and in what circumstances women GPs thrive at work.
abstract.textZh: 在利益相關者和患者參與的支持下，遵循現實主義的方法，使用現實主義邏輯分析了一系列已發佈的文件，以確定女性全科醫生如何、為什麼、為誰以及在什麼情況下在工作中茁壯成長。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: A total of 72 documents are included in this review. Sixteen configurations describe the conditions in which women GPs can thrive. Results cover the following three concepts: patient-facing work; navigating competing roles; and sustainable careers, leadership, and success. However, literature also places heavy reliance on encouraging women GPs to 'fix' their own circumstances.
abstract.textZh: 本次審核共包含72份文件。十六種配置描述了女性全科醫生可以茁壯成長的條件。結果涵蓋以下三個概念：面向患者的工作；導航相互競爭的角色；以及可持續的職業生涯、領導力和成功。然而，文獻也嚴重依賴鼓勵女性全科醫生「修復」自己的情況。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: This review provides evidence-based recommendations that may be of interest to those responsible for organisational culture within general practices, including (but not limited to) GP partners, and women GPs, who can utilise the recommendations to influence change.
abstract.textZh: 本審查提供以證據為基礎的建議，這些建議可能對一般實踐中負責組織文化的人員感興趣，包括（但不限於）全科醫生合作夥伴和女性全科醫生，他們可以利用這些建議來影響變革。

articles.titleZh: 調查女性全科醫生在一般診所中茁壯成長的條件：現實主義審查

articles.title: GP survivors' experiences working with family violence survivors: a qualitative study
articles.authors: Neil J, Delany C, McLindon E, Hegarty K

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Domestic and family violence (DFV) is common worldwide and GPs are not immune. DFV survivors frequently present to primary care where GP DFV survivors often encounter them. Little literature and no qualitative studies, to the authors' knowledge, have looked at the emotional and professional effects that these encounters have on survivor GPs, including how it affects their ability to care for survivor patients.
abstract.textZh: 家庭暴力（ DFV ）在世界各地都很常見，全科醫生也不能幸免。DFV倖存者經常出現在GP DFV倖存者經常遇到他們的初級保健中。據作者所知，很少有文獻和沒有定性研究研究了這些遭遇對倖存者全科醫生產生的情感和專業影響，包括它如何影響他們照顧倖存者患者的能力。

abstract.label: AIM
abstract.text: To answer the question: what are the experiences of survivor GPs when working with patient survivors of DFV?
abstract.textZh: 回答這個問題：倖存者全科醫生在與DFV患者倖存者合作時的經歷是什麼？

abstract.label: DESIGN AND SETTING
abstract.text: A phenomenological qualitative study, to gain a deep understanding of Australian GP DFV survivors' experiences when working with survivor patients.
abstract.textZh: 一項現象學定性研究，深入了解澳大利亞GP DFV倖存者在與倖存者患者合作時的經歷。

abstract.label: METHOD
abstract.text: Participants were Australian GPs self-identifying as survivors of all forms of DFV. Participants were recruited from two Australian GP online groups using purposive sampling. Semi-structured interviews took place and were audio-recorded and transcribed verbatim. Reflexive thematic analysis was undertaken.
abstract.textZh: 參與者是自我識別為所有形式DFV倖存者的澳大利亞全科醫生。參與者是使用有目的的抽樣從兩個澳大利亞全科醫生網上團體中招募的。進行了半結構化的訪談，並進行了錄音和逐字轉錄。進行反射性主題分析。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Participants (n = 20) were women and worked in a range of locations throughout Australia. Four themes were identified: 'my experiences can be my superpower' (encompassing the subthemes: 'having a sixth sense' and 'going above and beyond'); 'connecting with survivors' stories'; 'wearing a cloak'; and 'my experiences give me a sense of purpose'.
abstract.textZh: 參與者（ n = 20 ）為女性，在澳大利亞各地工作。確定了四個主題： “我的經歷可以成為我的超能力” （包括子主題： “擁有第六感”和“超越” ）; “與倖存者的故事聯繫”; “穿著鬥篷”;和“我的經歷給我一種目的感”。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: Although GP DFV survivors commonly experienced difficult emotions when working with survivor patients they had a commitment to this work that stemmed from personal DFV experiences. This increased their empathy for survivors and gave them a deep understanding of their circumstances, allowing them to work powerfully with survivors, aiming to improve their situation.
abstract.textZh: 雖然GP DFV倖存者在與倖存者患者合作時通常會經歷困難的情緒，但他們對這項工作的承諾源於個人的DFV經歷。這增加了他們對倖存者的同理心，並讓他們深入了解自己的情況，使他們能夠與倖存者強有力地合作，旨在改善他們的處境。

articles.titleZh: 全科醫生倖存者與家庭暴力倖存者合作的經驗：定性研究

articles.title: Association of the NHS Health Check with all-cause mortality: a longitudinal cohort study in primary care
articles.authors: Saund J, Dodhia H, Vanoli J, Masselot P, O'Neill S

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Cardiovascular disease (CVD) prevention is a policy priority because of widening inequalities and increasing preventable deaths. The NHS Health Check (NHS-HC) programme aims to promote early detection and prevention of CVD but has a wider-reaching impact owing to targeting multiple risk factors. Although programme evaluations demonstrate improvements in detection and surrogate markers, research on mortality outcomes remain limited, particularly using representative, real-world data.
abstract.textZh: 由於不平等擴大和可預防的死亡人數增加，心血管疾病（ CVD ）預防是政策優先事項。NHS健康檢查（ NHS-HC ）計劃旨在促進CVD的早期發現和預防，但由於針對多種風險因素，具有更廣泛的影響。儘管計劃評估顯示檢測和替代標記有所改善，但對死亡率結果的研究仍然有限，特別是使用具有代表性的真實世界數據。

abstract.label: AIM
abstract.text: To evaluate the effectiveness of NHS-HCs in reducing all-cause mortality.
abstract.textZh: 評估NHS-HCs在降低全因死亡率方面的有效性。

abstract.label: DESIGN AND SETTING
abstract.text: Longitudinal cohort study in an inner-city London borough.
abstract.textZh: 倫敦內城區的縱向隊列研究。

abstract.label: METHOD
abstract.text: Data from electronic primary care records were analysed for 158 645 eligible participants (2009-2023). Survival was modelled using a Cox proportional hazards model with time-varying exposure. All-cause mortality risk was compared between those attending ≥1 NHS-HC (n = 42 589) and those who did not (n = 116 056). Sociodemographic, geographic, and behavioural factors were adjusted using propensity score weighting.
abstract.textZh: 對158,645名合格參與者（ 2009-2023年）的電子初級護理記錄數據進行了分析。使用具有時變暴露的Cox比例風險模型對存活率進行建模。參加≥ 1 NHS-HC的患者（ n = 42 589 ）和未參加NHS-HC的患者（ n = 116 056 ）之間的全因死亡率風險進行了比較。使用傾向分數加權調整社會人口、地理和行為因素。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Of the 158 645 participants, 63 347 (39.9%) were of Black, Asian, mixed, or other ethnicity, and 100 825 (63.6%) lived in the two most deprived quintiles in England. Attendance at ≥1 NHS-HC was associated with lower mortality (adjusted hazard ratio 0.68, 95% confidence interval = 0.63 to 0.74), indicating a 32% reduction in risk. Ten-year absolute mortality risk reduction increased with age, with the largest difference among those aged 70-74 years (18.1% versus 12.9%). Sensitivity analyses supported these findings.
abstract.textZh: 在158 645名參與者中， 63 347人（ 39.9% ）為黑人、亞裔、混血或其他種族， 100 825人（ 63.6% ）居住在英格蘭最貧困的兩個五分之一人口中。≥ 1 NHS-HC的出勤率與較低的死亡率有關（調整後的風險比為0.68 ， 95%置信區間= 0.63至0.74 ） ，表明風險降低了32%。10年絕對死亡率風險降低隨著年齡的增長而增加，其中70-74歲之間的差異最大（ 18.1 ％對12.9 ％ ）。敏感性分析支持這些發現。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: This study suggests significant long-term survival benefit associated with the NHS-HC, supporting continued investment in and optimisation of the programme to provide population health benefits. Findings were robust to missing data assumptions and COVID-19, although residual confounding cannot be ruled out.
abstract.textZh: 這項研究表明，與NHS-HC相關的顯著長期生存益處，支持對該計劃的持續投資和優化，以提供人羣健康益處。雖然不能排除遺漏數據假設和COVID-19的殘留混淆，但調查結果對於遺漏數據假設和COVID-19來說是強有力的。

articles.titleZh: NHS健康檢查與全因死亡率的關聯：初級保健的縱向隊列研究

articles.title: Exploring GPs' prioritisation dilemmas - 'quick wins' versus 'eating the frog': a qualitative study in primary care
articles.authors: McClarey A, Dunsmore A, McNab D, Smith SE

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Prioritisation is an increasing part of a GP's workload, although learning this skill is usually left to on-the-job training. Little is known about how experienced GPs prioritise their workload.
abstract.textZh: 優先順序是全科醫生工作負荷中不斷增加的一部分，儘管學習這項技能通常留給在職培訓。對於經驗豐富的全科醫生如何優先處理工作量，知之甚少。

abstract.label: AIM
abstract.text: To explore the factors that experienced GPs consider when prioritising their acute workload.
abstract.textZh: 探索有經驗的全科醫生在優先考慮其急性工作量時所考慮的因素。

abstract.label: DESIGN AND SETTING
abstract.text: This qualitative research study used focus groups of GP educators based in central Scotland to explore the factors that they consider when prioritising their acute workload.
abstract.textZh: 這項定性研究使用位於蘇格蘭中部的全科醫生教育工作者焦點小組，探討他們在優先考慮其急性工作量時所考慮的因素。

abstract.label: METHOD
abstract.text: Participants were recruited through convenience sampling. The key inclusion criterion was being involved in the supervision of GP registrars. Five focus groups were carried out, and transcripts were analysed using reflexive thematic analysis to identify the dilemmas that GPs face when prioritising their workload.
abstract.textZh: 透過便利抽樣招募參與者。關鍵的納入標準是參與對全科醫生註冊機構的監督。進行五個焦點小組，並使用自反主題分析對成績單進行分析，以確定全科醫生在優先安排工作量時面臨的困境。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Thirty-nine participants took part. The following five themes emerged from the data: 1) system awareness and adapting to demand, whereby GPs maintain an awareness of their work system and adapt their consultation style to demand; 2) time management, which is where they make decisions in an order that manages their time efficiently; 3) familiarity with patients, which enables them to make quick decisions about patient care, although this can lead to bias in decision making; 4) relationships, whereby they rely on their therapeutic relationships with patients and working relationships with colleagues when making decisions; 5) personal preferences, which are important such as managing the simplest or the most complex presentations first.
abstract.textZh: 39名參與者參與了活動。從數據中得出以下五個主題： 1 ）系統意識和適應需求，即全科醫生保持對其工作系統的意識並根據需求調整其諮詢風格； 2 ）時間管理，即他們按照有效管理時間的順序做出決策； 3 ）熟悉患者，這使他們能夠就患者護理做出快速決定，儘管這可能導致決策偏見； 4 ）關係，即他們在做出決策時依靠與患者的治療關係和與同事的工作關係； 5 ）個人喜好，這很重要，例如首先管理最簡單或最複雜的演示。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: Prioritisation is an increasingly important skill in modern general practice. It is crucial that those involved in prioritisation are given the time and tools necessary to adequately develop this skill.
abstract.textZh: 在現代一般實踐中，優先順序是越來越重要的技能。為參與優先順序排序的人員提供充分發展此技能所需的時間和工具至關重要。

articles.titleZh: 探索全科醫生的優先順序困境-「速勝」與「吃青蛙」：初級保健的定性研究

articles.title: Does ethnicity affect primary palliative care identification and coding? An observational retrospective cohort study
articles.authors: Clarke G, Shuweihdi F, Relton SD, Trotter SA, Akhter Hussain J, Allsop M, Koffman J, Bennett MI, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Primary palliative care is symptom support and care for people with life-limiting illnesses incorporated within standard primary care. Early identification of needs is recommended best practice. There is limited research concerning ethnicity and primary palliative care identification and coding.
abstract.textZh: 初級姑息治療是對標準初級護理中包含的限制生命的疾病患者的症狀支持和護理。及早識別需求是建議的最佳做法。有關種族和初級姑息治療識別和編碼的研究有限。

abstract.label: AIM
abstract.text: To explore associations between ethnicity and primary palliative care identification and coding.
abstract.textZh: 探索種族和初級姑息治療識別和編碼之間的關聯。

abstract.label: DESIGN AND SETTING
abstract.text: A retrospective cohort study of deceased patients in England utilising anonymised primary care data extracted in February 2022.
abstract.textZh: 使用2022年2月提取的匿名初級護理數據，對英國已故患者進行的回溯性隊列研究。

abstract.label: METHOD
abstract.text: Multilevel logistic regression was used to examine associations between ethnicity and primary palliative care records. Cox regression was used to assess time from first record to death. Differences between first palliative care codes were examined using χ2 tests.
abstract.textZh: 使用多層次邏輯回歸來檢查種族和初級姑息治療記錄之間的關聯。Cox回歸法用於評估從首次記錄到死亡的時間。使用χ2檢測檢查首批姑息治療代碼之間的差異。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: A total of 200 876 patients were included; 32.30% (n = 64 887) had a primary palliative care record. Multilevel logistic regression (n = 64 887) showed no statistically significant association between ethnicity and identification after adjustment for age, sex, frailty, deprivation, and diagnosis. After adjustment, a mixed-effects Cox proportional hazards model (n = 58 681) indicated: compared with patients from White groups, patients from Asian (hazard ratio [HR] 0.944, 95% confidence interval [CI] = 0.891 to 0.999, P = 0.040) and Black, African, and Caribbean groups (HR 0.925, 95% CI = 0.862 to 0.992, P = 0.028) survived significantly longer; and patients from 'Other' groups had significantly shorter survival (HR 1.136, 95% CI = 1.046 to 1.234, P = 0.002). Patients from ethnic minority groups were significantly (P<0.001) more likely to have a first record of specialist palliative care compared with White groups.
abstract.textZh: 共有200 876名患者被納入； 32.30% （ n = 64 887 ）有初級姑息治療記錄。多層次邏輯回歸（ n = 64 887 ）顯示，在調整年齡、性別、脆弱性、剝奪和診斷後，種族和識別之間沒有統計學上顯著的關聯。調整後，混合效應Cox比例風險模型（ n = 58 681 ）顯示：與白人組的患者相比，來自亞洲（風險比[HR] 0.944 ， 95%置信區間[CI] = 0.891至0.999 ， P = 0.040 ）以及黑人、非洲和加勒比組（ HR 0.925 ， 95% CI = 0.862至0.992 ， P = 0.028 ）的患者存活時間顯著更長；來自「其他」組的患者存活時間顯著更短（ HR 1.136 ， 95% CI = 1.046至1.234 ， P = 0.002 ）。與白人組相比，來自少數民族羣體的患者顯著（ P < 0.001 ）更有可能有專科姑息治療的首次記錄。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: This study found no statistically significant association between ethnicity and primary palliative care identification after adjustment. However, differences were observed in survival and first palliative care activity. To ensure and monitor equitable access, ongoing improvements in palliative care identification and audits of data quality are required.
abstract.textZh: 調整後，本研究發現種族和初級姑息治療識別之間沒有統計學顯著關聯。然而，在存活期和第一次姑息治療活動中觀察到差異。為了確保和監控公平獲取，需要持續改善姑息治療識別和數據質量稽核。

articles.titleZh: 種族是否會影響初級姑息治療的識別和編碼？一項觀察性回溯性隊列研究

articles.title: Eczema, acne, and psoriasis in people with skin of colour: a qualitative UK-based study
articles.authors: Hutchison EJ, Parslow RM, Wainman HE, Ridd MJ

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Inflammatory dermatoses have a varied prevalence and appearance in diverse skin tones. The underrepresentation of people with skin of colour in medical education and clinical trials is widely acknowledged. However, there has been limited research on experiences from a patient perspective.
abstract.textZh: 炎症性皮膚病在不同的膚色中具有不同的患病率和外觀。在醫學教育和臨牀試驗中，有色人種的代表性不足是廣泛公認的。然而，從患者的角度來看，對經驗的研究有限。

abstract.label: AIM
abstract.text: To explore the experiences of eczema, acne, and psoriasis in adults with skin of colour in the UK.
abstract.textZh: 探索英國有色皮膚成人患濕疹、痤瘡和牛皮癬的經驗。

abstract.label: DESIGN AND SETTING
abstract.text: This was a qualitative study of 20 people in the UK with eczema, acne, and psoriasis and skin of colour, recruited using online methods.
abstract.textZh: 這是一項針對英國20名患有濕疹、痤瘡、牛皮癬和彩色皮膚的人進行的定性研究，使用線上方法招募。

abstract.label: METHOD
abstract.text: Participants took part in online, one-to-one, semi-structured interviews. NVivo qualitative data analysis software was used to code and organise the data. Reflexive thematic analysis was used to generate themes using an iterative approach.
abstract.textZh: 參與者參加了線上、一對一、半結構化的訪談。使用NVivo定性數據分析軟件對數據進行編碼和組織。反身主題分析被用於使用迭代方法產生主題。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Participants were mostly female (65%, 13/20), Asian/Asian British ethnicity (45%, 9/20), and had eczema (55%, 11/20). We identified eight themes: delayed or missed diagnosis; preferences regarding healthcare professionals; lack of online information and social media use; misunderstanding in cultural communities; concerns about treatment and lack of research in skin of colour; complementary medicine use; experiences and impact of dyspigmentation; and challenges with structural racism.
abstract.textZh: 參與者多為女性(65% ， 13/20)、亞裔/亞裔英國人(45% ， 9/20) ，並有濕疹(55% ， 11/20)。我們確定了八個主題：延遲或錯過診斷；對醫療保健專業人員的偏好；缺乏線上資訊和社交媒體使用；文化社區中的誤解；對治療的擔憂和缺乏對有色皮膚的研究；補充藥物的使用；色素紊亂的經驗和影響；以及結構性種族主義的挑戰。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: The themes generated highlight the unique experiences and challenges faced by UK adults with eczema, acne, and psoriasis. The findings can help guide diagnostic approaches, culturally sensitive communication, and treatment discussions for patients with skin of colour. Further research is needed in this underrepresented group.
abstract.textZh: 產生的主題突出了英國成年人患有濕疹、痤瘡和牛皮癬的獨特經驗和面臨的挑戰。這些發現可以幫助指導有色皮膚患者的診斷方法、文化敏感的溝通和治療討論。在這個代表性不足的羣體中，還需要進一步的研究。

articles.titleZh: 有色皮膚患者的濕疹、痤瘡和牛皮癬：一項基於英國的定性研究

articles.title: Catheter ablation for symptomatic atrial fibrillation (PVI-SHAM-AF): a randomised, double-blind, sham-controlled, multicentre trial
articles.authors: Wachter R, Haag P, Uhe T, Bacak M, Petroff D, Forkmann M, Eckardt L, Gaspar T, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Guidelines recommend catheter ablation for symptom relief in patients with atrial fibrillation. The aim of this trial was to ascertain whether catheter ablation improves atrial fibrillation-related quality of life more than a sham procedure.
abstract.textZh: 指南建議導管消融以緩解心房顫動患者的症狀。本試驗的目的是確定導管消融是否比假手術更能改善與心房顫動相關的生活質量。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: PVI-SHAM-AF was a double-blind, multicentre, randomised trial conducted at nine study sites in Germany and Poland. Patients aged 18 years or older with symptomatic paroxysmal or persistent atrial fibrillation were randomly assigned in a 2:1 ratio to catheter ablation or a sham procedure using an automated online randomisation system with variable block sizes, stratified by trial site. The primary endpoint was the between-group difference in change from baseline to 6 months in the Atrial Fibrillation Effect on the Quality-of-life Questionnaire (AFEQT) summary score. The prespecified primary analysis was done in the intention-to-treat population and included all randomly assigned patients, with missing data handled by multiple imputation. This trial is registered with ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT05119231) and 12-month follow-up is ongoing.
abstract.textZh: PVI-SHAM-AF是一項在德國和波蘭的九個研究中心進行的雙盲、多中心、隨機試驗。18歲或以上有症狀的發作性或持續性心房顫動的患者，以2: 1的比例隨機分配到導管消融或假手術，使用具有可變塊大小的自動線上隨機分組系統，並按試驗部位分層。主要評估指標是生活品質問卷(AFEQT)心房顫動效應(Atrial Fibrillation Effect on the Quality-of-life Questionnaire, AFEQT)總分從基線到6個月之間變化的組間差異。預先指定的主要分析是在意向治療族羣中進行的，包括所有隨機分配的患者，缺失的數據由多重估算處理。此試驗已在ClinicalTrials.gov （ NCT05119231 ）註冊，並且正在進行12個月的隨訪。

abstract.label: FINDINGS
abstract.text: Between Nov 12, 2021, and Nov 3, 2025, 1199 patients were invited to participate in the study and 262 patients consented and were randomly assigned: 173 patients to catheter ablation and 89 to sham. The median age was 67 years (IQR 62-73); 134 (51%) were female and 128 (49%) were male. Median follow-up was 184 days (IQR 181-191). At 6 months, the mean AFEQT summary score had increased from 61·3 (SD 20·1) to 81·1 (16·6) in the catheter ablation group and from 59·2 (19·0) to 74·9 (19·5) in the sham control group. The Hodges-Lehmann estimate of the between-group difference in change was 2·6 (95% CI -2·7 to 8·0; p=0·36). One death occurred in each group; neither was considered related to the study procedure. Serious adverse events adjudicated as related or possibly related to the study procedure occurred in ten unique patients: six patients in the catheter ablation group and four patients in the sham control group. One of these was an ischaemic stroke occurred in the sham control group.
abstract.textZh: 在2021年11月12日至2025年11月3日期間， 1199名患者受邀參與研究， 262名患者同意並被隨機分配： 173名患者進行導管消融， 89名患者進行假手術。中位數年齡為67歲（ IQR 62-73 ） ； 134名（ 51% ）為女性， 128名（ 49% ）為男性。中位隨訪時間為184天(IQR 181-191)。在6個月時，導管消融組的平均AFEQT總分從61 · 3 (SD 20 · 1)增加到81 · 1 (16 · 6) ，假對照組的平均AFEQT總分從59 · 2 (19 · 0)增加到74 · 9 (19 · 5)。組間變化差異的Hodges-Lehmann估計為2 · 6 （ 95 ％ CI -2 · 7至8 · 0 ； p = 0 · 36 ）。每組發生1例死亡；均未被認為與研究程序相關。判定與研究程序相關或可能相關的嚴重不良事件發生在10名獨特患者身上：導管消融組中有6名患者，假對照組中有4名患者。其中一個是假對照組發生的缺血性中風。

abstract.label: INTERPRETATION
abstract.text: Catheter ablation did not demonstrate superiority over a sham procedure for improving atrial fibrillation-related quality of life at 6 months.
abstract.textZh: 在6個月時，導管消融並未顯示出優於改善心房顫動相關生活質量的假手術。

articles.title: Cardiovascular disease in pregnancy: physiology, global burden, risk stratification, and opportunities in care
articles.authors: Brazile TL, Conrad N, Bergman L, Gnanaraj JP, Mehta LS, Silversides CK, Sliwa K, Sharma G, et al.

abstract.text: Cardiovascular disease remains one of the leading causes of maternal mortality worldwide and a major driver of long-term morbidity. Yet, pregnancy-related cardiovascular complications are often under-recognised and variably managed across global settings. This three-part Series examines the continuum of cardiovascular risk surrounding pregnancy-from preconception through to lifelong surveillance. In the first paper in this Series, we describe the haemodynamic changes of pregnancy and global trends of congenital and acquired heart disease before pregnancy, evaluate established risk-stratification tools, and discuss the importance of multidisciplinary care. We focus on the existing burden of cardiovascular disease during pregnancy and related maternal and fetal complications. The second paper focuses on hypertensive disorders of pregnancy-the most common cardiovascular complication during pregnancy worldwide-detailing the pathophysiology, risk factors, and innovative care-delivery models to bridge gaps in longitudinal management. Finally, the third paper examines the association between adverse pregnancy outcomes and future cardiovascular disease, delineating mechanistic pathways, early interventions, and subsequent cardiovascular care. Together, this Series underscores pregnancy as a pivotal window into women's lifelong cardiovascular health and calls for integrated, equitable strategies to prevent avoidable maternal and fetal complications, while substantially lowering the lifetime risk of cardiovascular disease across diverse populations.

articles.title: Aetiology, management, and outcomes of acute heart failure in 17 African countries (THESUS-HF II): a prospective, multicentre, observational cohort study
articles.authors: Sliwa K, Hahnle J, Stewart S, Allie S, Damasceno A, Smit D, Jessen N, Sani MU, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Contemporary data on the aetiology, management, and outcomes of acute heart failure across Africa are scarce. We aimed to conduct a contemporary assessment of acute heart failure aetiology, treatment patterns, presentation rates, and 180-day outcomes across Africa.
abstract.textZh: 關於整個非洲急性心力衰竭的病因學、管理和結果的當代數據很少。我們的目標是對整個非洲的急性心力衰竭病因、治療模式、呈現率和180天的結果進行當代評估。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: THESUS-HF II was a prospective, multicentre, observational cohort study in 50 hospitals across 17 African countries. Adults aged 18 years or older with acute heart failure were enrolled during seven 24 h surveillance periods within an 8-week, site-specific window. Acute heart failure was identified by acute dyspnoea and congestion, supported by electrocardiography, chest radiography, and point-of-care echocardiography. We assessed presentation rates per 10 000 people in the adult catchment population per week, treatment patterns (including medication use at discharge), readmission, and all-cause mortality through to 180 days. This study was registered with the Pan African Clinical Trial Registry (PACTR202410553810557) and is completed; however, substudies are ongoing.
abstract.textZh: THESUS-HF II是一項前瞻性、多中心、觀察性隊列研究，在17個非洲國家的50家醫院進行。18歲或以上患有急性心力衰竭的成年人在8週的特定研究中心窗口內的7個24小時監測期間入組。急性心力衰竭由急性呼吸困難和充血確定，並得到心電圖、胸片和即時心臟超音波檢查的支持。我們評估了每週成人流域人口中每萬人的呈現率、治療模式（包括出院時的藥物使用）、再入院率以及至180天的全因死亡率。本研究已在泛非臨牀試驗註冊處（ PACTR202410553810557 ）註冊並已完成；然而，子研究仍在進行中。

abstract.label: FINDINGS
abstract.text: Between July 1, 2024, and July 31, 2025, 1741 patients were assessed for eligibility at participating hospitals and 1578 were included in the study cohort. 793 (50·5%) of 1570 participants were female, 777 (49·5%) were male, and 1533 (97·8%) of 1567 were of African descent; median age was 56·0 years (IQR 40·0-69·0). The weekly acute heart failure presentation rate was 0·03 per 10 000 people (95% CI 0·02-0·05) overall and 0·02 per 10 000 people (0·01-0·04) for de novo acute heart failure. De novo acute heart failure accounted for 1007 (64·2%) of 1568 presentations. The leading aetiologies were hypertensive heart disease (576 [36·5%] of 1578), cardiomyopathy (370 [23·4%]), and ischaemic heart disease (367 [23·3%]). Median hospital ward stay was 6·0 days (IQR 4·0-10·0), and in-hospital mortality was 8·7% (95% CI 7·3-10·2; 134 of 1542 patients). At discharge, renin-angiotensin-aldosterone system inhibitors were prescribed in 1014 (73·9%) of 1373 patients, β blockers in 1053 (76·9%) of 1369 patients, mineralocorticoid receptor antagonists in 982 (71·9%) of 1366, and SGLT2 inhibitors in 743 (54·7%) of 1359; target doses were reached in fewer than half of patients. Of 1567 patients included in time-to-event analyses, 528 (33·7%) were lost to follow-up before 180 days. All-cause mortality was 11·1% (95% CI 9·6-12·9; 160 deaths) at 30 days and 20·6% (18·4-23·0; 255 deaths) at 180 days. All-cause mortality did not differ across aetiological groups over 30 days (log-rank p=0·39), but differed over 180 days (p=0·019).

articles.title: Adverse pregnancy outcomes and long-term cardiovascular disease risk
articles.authors: Pabón MA, Smith G, Sharma G, Catov J, Lewandowski AJ, Adam S, Honigberg MC, Cardiovascular Disease in Pregnancy Writing Group

abstract.text: Pregnancy provides a unique physiological stress test for the cardiovascular system, during which, adverse pregnancy outcomes (APOs) can unmask latent susceptibility to future disease. Common complications, including hypertensive disorders of pregnancy (HDP), gestational diabetes, and preterm birth (delivery before 37 weeks' gestation), identify women at substantially higher long-term risk of cardiovascular morbidity and mortality compared with women without a history of APOs. These excess risks likely reflect the combined effects of pre-existing cardiometabolic and genetic susceptibility, as well as the haemodynamic and metabolic stressors of pregnancy, heralding accelerated risk factor trajectories, relative impairment in endothelial and microvascular function, and early disease onset. This final Review in the Series extends the focus from cardiovascular disease during pregnancy and HDP to the long-term cardiovascular implications of APOs after delivery. We synthesise epidemiological data quantifying cardiovascular risk across major APO phenotypes and emerging evidence linking maternal APO history with cardiometabolic risk trajectories in offspring. We also delineate putative mechanistic pathways and summarise guidelines and consensus-informed recommendations for short-term and long-term follow-up after APOs. Finally, we propose practical approaches for integrating APO history into cardiovascular disease risk assessment and guideline-directed prevention across the female life course. We highlight key knowledge gaps, including uncertainty about optimal follow-up models, the limitations of current risk-stratification tools, and the absence of APO-specific prevention trials. We also outline priorities for mechanistic and implementation research. Positioning APOs as early, sex-specific indicators of cardiovascular risk offers a key window of opportunity to shift prevention upstream and improve cardiovascular health outcomes for women.

articles.title: Discontinuation of β-blockers in stable patients with previous myocardial infarction, preserved left ventricular ejection fraction, and no heart failure: a pooled analysis of individual patient data
articles.authors: Silvain J, Choi KH, Monguillon V, Kang D, Cayla G, Kim W, Ferrari E, Song YB, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Many stable patients with chronic coronary syndrome continue β-blocker therapy for years after a myocardial infarction, despite having no clear ongoing indication. Whether β-blockers can be safely discontinued in such patients remains uncertain. The objective of this analysis was to assess the non-inferiority of β-blocker discontinuation versus continuation in patients with previous myocardial infarction and no remaining indication.
abstract.textZh: 儘管沒有明確的持續適應症，但許多穩定的慢性冠狀動脈綜合症患者在心肌梗塞後繼續β受體阻斷劑治療多年。在這類患者中是否可以安全停用β受體阻斷劑仍不確定。本分析的目的是評估既往有心肌梗塞且無剩餘適應症的患者停用β受體阻斷劑與繼續停用β受體阻斷劑的非劣效性。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: We performed a pooled analysis of individual patient data from the ABYSS and SMART-DECISION randomised trials in stable patients over 6 months after a myocardial infarction with a left ventricular ejection fraction of ≥40% and no heart failure. Non-inferiority was assessed for the composite primary endpoint of all-cause death, myocardial infarction, stroke, or hospitalisation for cardiovascular reasons, and for the key secondary endpoint of all-cause death, myocardial infarction, or hospitalisation for heart failure. Analyses used a one-stage mixed-effects Cox proportional hazards model including trial as a random effect with margins of 1·25 for the primary endpoint and 1·40 for the key secondary endpoint. The review protocol was registered with PROSPERO, number CRD420261299839.
abstract.textZh: 我們對來自ABYSS和SMART-DECISION隨機試驗的個體患者數據進行了匯總分析，這些試驗是在左心室射血分數≥ 40%且無心力衰竭的心肌梗塞後超過6個月的穩定患者中進行的。評估全因死亡、心肌梗塞、中風或因心血管原因住院的複合主要終點，以及全因死亡、心肌梗塞或因心力衰竭住院的關鍵次要終點的非劣效性。分析使用一階段混合效應Cox比例風險模型，包括作為隨機效應的試驗，主要終點的邊際值為1 · 25 ，關鍵次要終點的邊際值為1 · 40。審查方案在PROSPERO註冊，編號為CRD420261299839。

abstract.label: FINDINGS
abstract.text: Among 6238 patients (3698 from ABYSS and 2540 from SMART-DECISION), 3092 were assigned to β-blocker discontinuation and 3146 to continuation. Median time from index myocardial infarction to randomisation was 3·6 years (IQR 1·6-7·5) and median follow-up was 3·0 years (2·3-3·8). The primary endpoint occurred in 532 (17·2%) of 3092 patients in the β-blocker discontinuation group and 500 (15·9%) of 3146 in the continuation group (hazard ratio 1·09 [95% CI 0·97-1·24]; pnon-inferiority=0·016). The key secondary endpoint occurred in 201 (6·5%) of 3092 patients in the discontinuation group and 201 (6·4%) of 3146 patients in the continuation group (1·01 [0·83-1·23]; pnon-inferiority=0·0006). Findings were consistent irrespective of background left ventricular ejection fraction.
abstract.textZh: 在6238名患者（ 3698名來自ABYSS ， 2540名來自SMART-DECISION ）中， 3092名被分配停用β受體阻斷劑， 3146名被分配繼續服用。從指標性心肌梗死到隨機分配的中位時間為3.6年（ IQR 1.6-7.5 ） ，中位隨訪時間為3.0年（ 2.3-3.8 ）。主要終點發生在β受體阻斷劑停藥組的3092名患者中的532名（ 17.2% ）和繼續治療組的3146名患者中的500名（ 15.9% ） （風險比1 · 09 [95% CI 0 · 97-1 · 24] ；非劣效性= 0 · 016 ）。關鍵次要終點發生在停藥組的3092名患者中的201名（ 6.5 ％ ）和繼續組的3146名患者中的201名（ 6.4 ％ ） （ 1 · 01 [0 · 83-1 · 23] ；非劣效性= 0 · 0006 ）。無論左心室背景射血分數如何，結果都是一致的。

abstract.label: INTERPRETATION
abstract.text: In stable patients with previous myocardial infarction, left ventricular ejection fraction ≥40%, no heart failure, and no other indication for β-blocker therapy, discontinuation met the non-inferiority criteria for the primary and key secondary endpoints. Interpretation of the primary endpoint is limited by its hospitalisation-heavy and trial-dependent composition.

articles.title: Low-Voltage Ablation in Persistent Atrial Fibrillation: The IDEAL-AF Randomized Clinical Trial
articles.authors: Paul Nordin A, Charitakis E, Carnlöf C, Åkerström F, Saluveer O, Almroth H, Karlsson LO, Hassel Jönsson A, et al.

abstract.label: IMPORTANCE
abstract.text: Pulmonary vein isolation remains the foundational ablation approach for atrial fibrillation (AF), yet outcomes in persistent AF remain suboptimal. Targeting low-voltage zones identified by electroanatomical mapping offers a promising strategy for enhancing ablation success.
abstract.textZh: 肺靜脈隔離仍然是心房顫動（ AF ）的基礎消融方法，但持續性AF的結果仍然不理想。針對通過電解剖映射識別的低電壓區域為增強消融成功提供了有希望的策略。

abstract.label: OBJECTIVE
abstract.text: To determine whether adjunctive individualized low-voltage zone ablation improves arrhythmia outcomes and health-related quality of life beyond pulmonary vein isolation alone in patients with persistent AF and significant low-voltage zones.
abstract.textZh: 確定輔助個體化低電壓區域消融是否能改善持續性房顫和顯著低電壓區域患者的心律失常結果和健康相關的生活質量，而不僅僅是肺靜脈隔離。

abstract.label: DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS
abstract.text: Multicenter randomized clinical trial with 12 months of follow-up conducted at 5 Swedish ablation centers between May 18, 2020, and April 9, 2026. Of 936 adult patients undergoing first-time ablation and voltage mapping for persistent AF, 209 with low-voltage zones of 3.0 cm2 or greater were randomized.
abstract.textZh: 多中心隨機臨牀試驗，於2020年5月18日至2026年4月9日期間在5個瑞典消融中心進行12個月的隨訪。在936名進行持續性房顫的首次消融和電壓映射的成人患者中， 209名低電壓區域為3.0 cm2或更高的患者被隨機分組。

abstract.label: INTERVENTIONS
abstract.text: Following pulmonary vein isolation, patients with significant low-voltage zones were randomized to either receive individualized adjunctive low-voltage zone ablation (n = 102) or receive no further ablation (n = 107).
abstract.textZh: 在肺靜脈隔離後，具有顯著低電壓區域的患者被隨機分配接受個別輔助低電壓區域消融術（ n = 102 ）或不接受進一步消融術（ n = 107 ）。

abstract.label: MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES
abstract.text: The primary outcome was freedom from documented atrial arrhythmia without antiarrhythmic drugs at 12 months after 1 or 2 ablation procedures within 6 months. Secondary outcomes were time to first recurrence after a single procedure without antiarrhythmic drugs, health-related quality of life, and safety.
abstract.textZh: 主要結果是在6個月內進行1或2次消融手術後12個月內，沒有記錄的房性心律失常，沒有抗心律失常藥物。次要結果是在沒有抗心律失常藥物、健康相關生活質量和安全性的單一手術後首次復發的時間。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Among the 209 randomized patients (median age, 72 years; 109 females [52.2%]), the primary outcome was achieved more frequently in the pulmonary vein isolation plus low-voltage zone ablation group than in the pulmonary vein isolation alone group. Arrhythmia-free survival was achieved in 69 patients (67.6%) vs 40 patients (37.4%), respectively (unadjusted difference, 30.3% [95% CI, 17.4%-43.2%]; odds ratio, 3.5 [95% CI, 2.0-6.2]; P < .001). Time to first recurrence after a single ablation procedure without antiarrhythmic drugs also favored low-voltage zone ablation (hazard ratio, 0.4; 95% CI, 0.3-0.6; P < .001). Improvements in health-related quality of life were greater in the low-voltage zone ablation group, whereas rates of serious adverse events were similar between groups.
abstract.textZh: 在209名隨機分組患者（中位年齡， 72歲； 109名女性[52.2%] ）中，肺靜脈隔離加低電壓區域消融組的主要結果比單獨肺靜脈隔離組更常見。69名患者（ 67.6% ）與40名患者（ 37.4% ）分別達到無心律失常生存期（未調整差異， 30.3% [95% CI ， 17.4% -43.2%] ；比值比， 3.5 [95% CI ， 2.0-6.2] ； P < 0.001 ）。在沒有抗心律失常藥物的單次消融手術後的首次復發時間也有利於低電壓區域消融（風險比， 0.4 ； 95% CI ， 0.3-0.6 ； P < 0.001 ）。低電壓區域消融組的健康相關生活質量改善更大，而各組之間的嚴重不良事件發生率相似。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE
abstract.text: Adjunctive low-voltage zone ablation added to pulmonary vein isolation improved rhythm outcomes and health-related quality of life without increasing serious adverse events in patients with persistent AF and significant low-voltage zones. These findings support a low-voltage zone-guided ablation strategy in this population.

articles.title: Gene Silencer Therapy in Transthyretin Amyloid Cardiomyopathy: A Meta-Analysis of Outcomes Trials
articles.authors: Gillmore JD, Hamatani Y, Fontana M, Vaduganathan M, Claggett BL, Garcia-Pavia P, Masri A, Cappelli F, et al.

abstract.label: IMPORTANCE
abstract.text: Gene-silencing therapies reduce hepatic transthyretin (TTR) production and have been evaluated in phase 3 trials in TTR amyloid cardiomyopathy (ATTR-CM). However, differences in trial design and background therapies have limited assessment of the overall treatment effect and its consistency according to baseline TTR stabilizer use.
abstract.textZh: 基因沉默療法可減少肝臟轉甲狀腺素蛋白(TTR)的產生，並已在TTR澱粉樣心肌病(ATTR-CM)的3期試驗中進行評估。然而，試驗設計和背景療法的差異限制了根據基線TTR穩定劑使用對整體治療效果及其一致性的評估。

abstract.label: OBJECTIVE
abstract.text: To assess the effect of TTR gene-silencing therapies in patients with ATTR-CM.
abstract.textZh: 評估TTR基因沉默療法對ATTR-CM患者的影響。

abstract.label: DATA SOURCES AND STUDY SELECTION
abstract.text: PubMed was searched through June 15, 2026, for randomized, placebo-controlled, phase 3 outcome trials of gene-silencing therapies in ATTR-CM.
abstract.textZh: PubMed在2026年6月15日之前進行了搜尋，以進行ATTR-CM基因沉默療法的隨機、安慰劑對照、3期結果試驗。

abstract.label: DATA EXTRACTION AND SYNTHESIS
abstract.text: Two reviewers independently extracted data, following the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) guideline. Fixed-effects meta-analysis estimated rate ratios (RRs) or hazard ratios (HRs) with 95% CIs.
abstract.textZh: 兩位審查者根據系統性審查和後設分析(PRISMA)的首選報告項目指南，獨立提取資料。固定效應薈萃分析95%信賴區間的估計比率(RR)或風險比率(HR)。

abstract.label: MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES
abstract.text: The prespecified primary outcome was the composite of all-cause mortality and recurrent cardiovascular events. Secondary outcomes included all-cause mortality, cardiovascular death, time to first primary outcome, functional capacity (6-minute walk distance), and health status (Kansas City Cardiomyopathy Questionnaire-Overall Summary Score).
abstract.textZh: 預先指定的主要結果是全因死亡率和復發性心血管事件的綜合結果。次要結果包括全因死亡率、心血管死亡、至首次主要結果的時間、功能容量（步行6分鐘距離）和健康狀況（堪薩斯城心肌病問卷-整體總分）。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: A total of 2 studies (HELIOS-B and CARDIO-TTRansform) met the inclusion criteria and included 2086 patients with ATTR-CM. The studies included 1902 men with a median age of 77 years (range for HELIOS-B, 45-85 years; for CARDIO-TTRansform, 41-91 years). Gene-silencing therapy reduced the primary end point by 20% (RR, 0.80; 95% CI, 0.69-0.94; P = .006), with no heterogeneity between trials (P for heterogeneity = .28). Gene-silencing therapy also reduced the risk of all-cause death (HR, 0.74; 95% CI, 0.61-0.91) and time to first all-cause death or cardiovascular events (HR, 0.77; 95% CI, 0.67-0.89) compared with placebo. Gene silencers preserved 6-minute walk distance (placebo-corrected difference, +22.2 m; 95% CI, 14.3-30.0) and Kansas City Cardiomyopathy Questionnaire-Overall Summary Score (+4.5; 95% CI, 2.7-6.2), with no evidence of between-trial heterogeneity. Treatment effects on primary end points differed according to baseline stabilizer use, with significant benefits observed among patients not receiving background stabilizer therapy (RR, 0.69; 95% CI, 0.57-0.85) and no significant incremental benefit observed for those receiving concomitant stabilizer at baseline (RR, 0.97; 95% CI, 0.77-1.23; P for heterogeneity = .03). Similar heterogeneity was observed for functional capacity and health status.
abstract.textZh: 共有2項研究（ HELIOS-B和CARDIO-TTRansform ）符合納入標準，包括2086名ATTR-CM患者。 這些研究包括1902名中位年齡為77歲的男性（ HELIOS-B的範圍為45-85歲； CARDIO-TTRansform的範圍為41-91歲）。 基因沉默療法使主要終點降低了20% （ RR ， 0.80 ； 95% CI ， 0.69-0.94 ； P = .006 ） ，試驗之間沒有異質性（ P表示異質性= .28 ）。 與安慰劑相比，基因沉默療法還降低了全因死亡的風險（ HR ， 0.74 ； 95% CI ， 0.61-0.91 ）和至首次發生全因死亡或心血管事件的時間（ HR ， 0.77 ； 95% CI ， 0.67-0.89 ）。 基因消音器保留了6分鐘的步行距離（安慰劑校正差異， +22.2 m ； 95% CI ， 14.3-30.0 ）和堪薩斯城心肌病問卷-整體總分（ +4.5 ； 95% CI ， 2.7-6.2 ） ，沒有試驗間異質性的證據。 根據基線期穩定劑的使用，治療對主要終點的影響有所不同，在未接受背景穩定劑治療的患者中觀察到顯著的益處（ RR ， 0.69 ； 95% CI ， 0.57-0.85 ） ，而在基線期接受伴隨穩定劑的患者中觀察到無顯著的增量益處（ RR ， 0.97 ； 95% CI ， 0.77-1.23 ；異質性P = 0.03 ）。 在功能容量和健康狀態方面觀察到類似的異質性。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE
abstract.text: The findings from this meta-analysis support TTR gene silencing for ATTR-CM. The attenuated benefit observed for patients receiving concomitant TTR stabilizer therapy may reflect residual differences in case mix, disease duration, or magnitude of TTR suppression or a true ceiling on additional benefit of gene silencing in the setting of background TTR stabilization.

articles.title: 124I-Evuzamitide Positron Emission Tomography/Computed Tomography for Diagnosing Cardiac Amyloidosis: The REVEAL Nonrandomized Clinical Trial
articles.authors: Dorbala S, Maurer MS, Cuddy SAM, AbouEzzeddine OF, Di Carli MF, Dilsizian V, Dispenzieri A, Gallegos-Kattán C, et al.

abstract.label: IMPORTANCE
abstract.text: Diagnosing cardiac amyloidosis remains challenging because current imaging approaches are limited to transthyretin amyloidosis. A noninvasive test capable of directly imaging cardiac amyloidosis from various amyloid types and in multiple organs could address an important unmet diagnostic need.
abstract.textZh: 診斷心肌澱粉樣變性仍然具有挑戰性，因為目前的成像方法僅限於轉甲狀腺素澱粉樣變性。非侵入性測試能夠直接從各種澱粉樣蛋白類型和多個器官中對心臟性澱粉樣變性進行成像，可以解決重要的未滿足的診斷需求。

abstract.label: OBJECTIVE
abstract.text: To evaluate the sensitivity and specificity of 124I-evuzamitide positron emission tomography (PET)/computed tomography (CT) for diagnosing cardiac amyloidosis.
abstract.textZh: 評估124I-Evuzamitide正電子發射斷層掃描(PET)/電腦斷層掃描(CT)診斷心臟性澱粉樣變性的敏感性和特異性。

abstract.label: DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS
abstract.text: Prospective, multicenter (18 US centers), single-group study evaluating the efficacy of 124I-evuzamitide to diagnose cardiac amyloidosis. This study was conducted from January 14, 2025, to March 12, 2026, including a 60-day follow-up period. Three physicians with cardiac PET/CT experience independently reviewed PET/CT images for visual cardiac 124I-evuzamitide uptake while blinded to clinical data. Three expert clinical amyloidosis physicians, blinded to PET/CT data, independently adjudicated the diagnosis based on the standard-of-care diagnostic algorithm. A total of 195 adults suspected of having cardiac amyloidosis were enrolled when they presented for diagnostic evaluation at participating institutions, excluding patients with an established diagnosis of cardiac or systemic amyloidosis.
abstract.textZh: 前瞻性、多中心（ 18個美國中心）、單組研究，評估124I-依伐他汀診斷心臟性澱粉樣變性的療效。本研究從2025年1月14日至2026年3月12日進行，包括60天的追蹤期。三位有心臟PET/CT經驗的醫生獨立審查了PET/CT影像，以便在對臨牀數據視而不見的情況下進行視覺心臟124I-依伐他汀攝取。三位專業的臨牀澱粉樣變性醫生，對PET/CT數據視而不見，根據標準護理診斷算法獨立判斷診斷。在參與機構進行診斷評估時，共有195名懷疑患有心臟性澱粉樣變性的成人入組，不包括已確診為心臟性或全身性澱粉樣變性的患者。

abstract.label: INTERVENTIONS
abstract.text: PET/CT scans were obtained 3 to 5 hours after intravenous administration of 1 mCi of 124I-evuzamitide. Potassium iodide (130 mg) was given orally for 3 days starting at least 30 minutes prior to 124I-evuzamitide injection.
abstract.textZh: 在靜脈注射1 mCi的124I-依武扎米特後3至5小時獲得PET/CT掃描。在124I-依伐他汀注射前至少30分鐘開始口服碘化鉀(130 mg) 3天。

abstract.label: MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES
abstract.text: Coprimary end points of this study were to assess the sensitivity and specificity of 124I-evuzamitide for the diagnosis of cardiac amyloidosis.
abstract.textZh: 本研究的共同主要終點是評估124I-evuzamitide在診斷心臟性澱粉樣變性方面的敏感性和特異性。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Overall, 170 patients were included (median [IQR] age, 72 [64-79] years; 75.3% male, 19.2% Black, 79.0% White). Median N-terminal pro-brain natriuretic peptide was 471 pg/mL and 61.7% had New York Heart Association class II or III heart failure symptoms. The overall sensitivity was 94% (95% CI, 85%-98%; P < .001); specificity, 86% (95% CI, 77%-92%; P < .001); positive predictive value, 85% (95% CI, 75%-92%); and negative predictive value, 94% (95% CI, 87%-98%).
abstract.textZh: 總體而言，納入了170名患者（中位[IQR]年齡， 72 [64-79]歲； 75.3%男性， 19.2%黑人， 79.0%白人）。N末端前腦利鈉肽中位數為471 pg/mL ， 61.7%有紐約心臟協會II或III級心臟衰竭症狀。整體敏感性為94% （ 95% CI ， 85% -98% ； P < 0.001 ） ；特異性為86% （ 95% CI ， 77% -92% ； P < 0.001 ） ；陽性預測值為85% （ 95% CI ， 75% -92% ） ；陰性預測值為94% （ 95% CI ， 87% -98% ）。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE
abstract.text: 124I-evuzamitide PET/CT is highly sensitive and specific for diagnosing cardiac amyloidosis with an acceptable safety profile. These results support 124I-evuzamitide PET/CT as a diagnostic test to evaluate patients with suspected cardiac amyloidosis.
abstract.textZh: 124I-evuzamitide PET/CT對於診斷心臟性澱粉樣變性具有高度敏感性和特異性，具有可接受的安全性。這些結果支持124I-Evuzamitide PET/CT作為診斷測試，以評估疑似心肌澱粉樣變性的患者。

articles.title: Anticoagulation Monotherapy vs Antiplatelet Monotherapy After Transcatheter Aortic Valve Implant: The ACASA-TAVI Randomized Clinical Trial
articles.authors: Dodgson CS, Herstad J, Kløve SF, Flygel M, Akhavi M, Høie S, Beitnes JO, Eek CH, et al.

abstract.label: IMPORTANCE
abstract.text: Transcatheter aortic valve implant (TAVI) is increasingly being performed in younger and healthier patients with severe aortic valve stenosis. Antithrombotic therapy after TAVI is a key element of optimizing valve durability and clinical outcomes.
abstract.textZh: 經導管主動脈瓣植入術（ TAVI ）越來越多地在年輕和健康的重度主動脈瓣狹窄患者中進行。TAVI後的抗血栓治療是優化瓣膜耐久性和臨牀結果的關鍵要素。

abstract.label: OBJECTIVE
abstract.text: To evaluate the safety and efficacy of a factor Xa inhibitor non-vitamin K antagonist oral anticoagulant (NOAC) monotherapy strategy vs an acetylsalicylic acid (ASA) monotherapy strategy after TAVI.
abstract.textZh: 評估TAVI後Xa因子抑制劑非維生素K拮抗劑口服抗凝劑（ NOAC ）單一治療策略與乙酰水楊酸（ ASA ）單一治療策略的安全性和有效性。

abstract.label: DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS
abstract.text: Between December 2021 and June 2025, 360 participants between the ages of 65 and 80 years undergoing TAVI for severe aortic valve stenosis were enrolled in this prospective, randomized, open-label, blinded end point trial conducted at 3 Norwegian centers managing the majority of TAVI procedures nationally. The last patient completed follow-up on May 19, 2026.
abstract.textZh: 在2021年12月至2025年6月期間， 360名年齡在65至80歲之間因嚴重主動脈瓣狹窄而接受TAVI的參與者參加了這項前瞻性、隨機、開放標籤、盲法終點試驗，該試驗在管理全國大多數TAVI手術的3個挪威中心進行。最後一位患者於2026年5月19日完成隨訪。

abstract.label: INTERVENTION
abstract.text: A total of 360 participants were randomly assigned (1:1) to receive 12 months of monotherapy with either NOAC (intervention) or ASA (control).
abstract.textZh: 總共360名參與者被隨機分配（ 1 ： 1 ）接受12個月的NOAC （幹預）或ASA （對照）單一治療。

abstract.label: MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES
abstract.text: A predefined co-primary end point strategy was chosen to address both efficacy and safety. The primary efficacy end point was TAVI valve leaflet thrombosis defined as the presence of hypoattenuated leaflet thickening (HALT) on blinded core laboratory 4-dimensional cardiac computed tomographic (CT) scan at 12 months. The primary safety end point was a composite of adjudicated Valve Academic Research Consortium 3 (VARC-3) bleeding events, thromboembolic events, and all-cause death at 12 months.
abstract.textZh: 選擇了預先定義的共同主要終點策略來解決有效性和安全性。主要療效終點是TAVI瓣膜葉片血栓形成，定義為在盲法核心實驗室4維心臟電腦斷層掃描(CT)中，在12個月時出現低密度葉片增厚(HALT)。主要安全性終點是經判定的Valve Academic Research Consortium 3 (VARC-3)出血事件、血栓栓塞事件和12個月全因死亡的綜合結果。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Of the 360 participants randomized (mean age, 74.5 years [SD, 3.7]; 134 females [37%]), 336 completed the trial (168 in each group). The primary efficacy end point occurred in 27 participants (16.2%) allocated to the NOAC group and in 48 participants (28.6%) allocated to the ASA group (risk ratio, 0.55; 95% CI, 0.37 to 0.82, P = .004). The primary safety end point occurred in 13 participants (7.5%) in the NOAC group and in 19 participants (10.6%) in the ASA group (risk difference, -3.3%; 95% CI, -9.5% to 2.8%; P for noninferiority <.001).
abstract.textZh: 在隨機分配的360名參與者中（平均年齡為74.5歲[SD ， 3.7] ； 134名女性[37%] ） ， 336人完成了試驗（每組168人）。主要療效終點發生在分配給NOAC組的27名參與者（ 16.2% ）和分配給ASA組的48名參與者（ 28.6% ） （風險比率， 0.55 ； 95% CI ， 0.37至0.82 ， P = 0.004 ）。主要安全性終點發生在NOAC組的13名參與者（ 7.5% ）和ASA組的19名參與者（ 10.6% ） （風險差異， -3.3% ； 95% CI ， -9.5%至2.8% ；非劣效性P < 0.001 ）。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE
abstract.text: A strategy of NOAC monotherapy after TAVI reduced the incidence of HALT and was noninferior for bleeding, thromboembolic events, or death compared with acetylsalicylic acid monotherapy. These findings suggest that anticoagulation therapy can be beneficial after TAVI in selected patients.
abstract.textZh: 與乙酰水楊酸單藥治療相比， TAVI後的NOAC單藥治療策略降低了HALT的發生率，並且在出血、血栓栓塞事件或死亡方面非劣勢。這些發現表明，在選定的患者中，抗凝療法在TAVI後可能是有益的。

articles.title: Safety and efficacy of the 0/1 h pathway for myocardial infarction in the emergency department: an international, pragmatic, stepped-wedge, cluster-randomised, controlled trial
articles.authors: Boeddinghaus J, Bima P, Crisanti L, Keller DI, Slankamenac K, Christ M, Schuetz P, Wiencierz A, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: The evaluation of patients with suspected myocardial infarction relies on serial measurements of high-sensitivity cardiac troponin. We aimed to evaluate the safety and efficacy of implementing the guideline-recommended 0/1 h pathway, compared with a 0/3 h pathway, in hospitals that had not yet adopted the newer strategy.
abstract.textZh: 對疑似心肌梗塞患者的評估依賴於高敏感性心肌肌鈣蛋白的連續測量。我們旨在評估在尚未採用較新策略的醫院中實施指南建議的0/1小時途徑與0/3小時途徑的安全性和有效性。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: PRESC1SE-MI was an international, pragmatic, stepped-wedge, cluster-randomised, controlled, masked-endpoint trial at 19 hospitals in ten countries. The study included consecutive adults presenting to the emergency department with acute non-traumatic chest discomfort and suspected myocardial infarction. Hospitals using a 0/3 h pathway (blood draws at 0 h and 3 h) as standard care were randomly allocated to implement the 0/1 h pathway (blood draws at 0 h and 1 h) after 6 months (early implementation) or 12 months (late implementation). The trial was designed to test the non-inferiority of the 0/1 h pathway for safety and its superiority for efficacy. The non-inferiority margin was set at an odds ratio of 1·3. Analyses were done in the full analysis set. The coprimary safety outcome was a composite of death from any cause or new type 1 myocardial infarction within 30 days, and the coprimary efficacy outcome was emergency department length of stay. This trial is registered with ClinicalTrials.gov, NCT05649384, and is active but no longer enrolling.
abstract.textZh: PRESC1SE-MI是一項國際性、務實、階梯式楔形、叢集隨機、對照、遮罩端點試驗，在10個國家的19家醫院進行。 該研究包括連續的成年人，他們在急診室出現急性非創傷性胸部不適和疑似心肌梗塞。 在6個月（早期實施）或12個月（晚期實施）後，使用0/3小時途徑（在0小時和3小時抽血）作為標準護理的醫院被隨機分配以實施0/1小時途徑（在0小時和1小時抽血）。 該試驗旨在測試0/1小時通路的安全性和有效性的非劣效性。 非劣效性邊際設定為比值比1 · 3。 在完整的分析集中完成分析。 共原發安全性結果是30天內任何原因或新發1型心肌梗死死亡的綜合結果，而共原發有效性結果是急診科住院時間。 此試驗已在ClinicalTrials.gov註冊，編號為NCT05649384 ，目前正在進行，但不再招募。

abstract.label: FINDINGS
abstract.text: Between Dec 1, 2020, and Dec 31, 2024, 71 983 consecutive patient presentations were screened, of which 67 624 (93·9%) met the eligibility criteria and comprised the full analysis set. Median age was 59 years (IQR 46-73); 29 954 (44·3%) patient presentations were in female patients and 37 670 (55·7%) were in male patients. 13 753 (22·2%) of 62 060 patient presentations with available data were in patients with known coronary artery disease, and 5855 (8·7%) patient presentations had an adjudicated index diagnosis of myocardial infarction. Overall, 36 464 patient presentations were managed with a 0/3 h pathway and 31 160 with the 0/1 h pathway. Death from any cause or new type 1 myocardial infarction occurred in 454 (1·2%) patient presentations in the 0/3 h group and in 341 (1·1%) patient presentations in the 0/1 h group (adjusted odds ratio 0·93 [95% CI 0·77-1·13]; pnon-inferiority=0·0004). The median emergency department length of stay was 309 min (IQR 203-470) in the 0/3 h pathway and 309 min (207-474) in the 0/1 h pathway (ratio of adjusted median times 1·00 [95% CI 0·97-1·02]; two-sided p=0·65).
abstract.textZh: 在2020年12月1日至2024年12月31日期間，篩選了71 983例連續的患者呈現，其中67 624 （ 93.9 ％ ）符合資格標準，並包含完整的分析集。 中位年齡為59歲（ IQR 46-73 ） ； 29,954 （ 44.3 ％ ）名患者呈現女性患者和37,670 （ 55.7 ％ ）名男性患者。在有可用數據的62,060名患者呈現中， 13,753 （ 22.2 ％ ）名患者呈現已知冠狀動脈疾病的患者， 5,855 （ 8.7 ％ ）名患者呈現心肌梗塞的判定指標診斷。 總體而言， 36,464名患者以0/3小時的途徑進行治療， 31,160名患者以0/1小時的途徑進行治療。 0/3小時組的454 (1 · 2%)名患者和0/1小時組的341 (1 · 1%)名患者因任何原因或新發1型心肌梗死而死亡(調整比值比0 · 93 [95% CI 0 · 77-1 · 13] ；非劣效性= 0 · 0004)。 0/3小時路徑的急診科住院時間中位數為309分鐘(IQR 203-470) ， 0/1小時路徑的住院時間中位數為309分鐘(207-474) (調整後的中位數時間比值1 · 00 [95% CI 0 · 97-1 · 02] ；雙側p = 0 · 65)。

abstract.label: INTERPRETATION
abstract.text: Implementation of the 0/1 h pathway met the prespecified non-inferiority criterion for the 30-day composite safety outcome but did not shorten emergency department length of stay compared with the 0/3 h pathway. In this setting, implementation of the 0/1 h pathway alone should therefore not be expected to improve emergency department throughput.
abstract.textZh: 0/1小時路徑的實施符合30天綜合安全性結果的預先指定的非劣效性標準，但與0/3小時路徑相比，並未縮短急診部門的住院時間。因此，在這種情況下，僅實施0/1小時路徑不應提高急診科的吞吐量。

articles.title: Systematic reviews and the needs of the adolescent transgender health care field
articles.authors: Doyle DM, de Vries ALC

abstract.text: Gender-affirming medical treatment for adolescents (defined as the start of puberty to age 18 years) has become an increasingly contested area of medicine in recent years. 13 reviews have been conducted since 2017 (with seven since 2023) to summarise studies on the potential effects of pubertal suppression and gender-affirming hormone therapy on psychosocial, cognitive, and physical outcomes in adolescents who are transgender, gender diverse, or non-binary. As systematic reviews are seen as the highest quality of sources of empirical knowledge according to the principles of evidence-based medicine, these reviews have far-reaching influence on government and health-care policies and practice, and prompt broader societal debates. In this Viewpoint, we review the conclusions of these systematic reviews regarding the efficacy and safety of pubertal suppression and gender-affirming hormone therapy for adolescents, and examine how these reviews are being misused to influence treatment options and care pathways. We affirm that the development of clinical guidelines should be underpinned by all three facets of evidence-based medicine (ie, empirical evidence, clinical expertise, and patient values), as evaluated by experts in the field.

articles.title: Pre-eclampsia
articles.authors: Walker MC, Murphy MSQ, Scremin Souza SC, Koi-Larbi K, Costa ML, Hyett J, Dadelszen PV, Magee LA, et al.

abstract.text: Pre-eclampsia is a multisystem disorder that arises in at least 2-4% of pregnancies and is characterised by hypertension and new-onset organ dysfunction. The pathophysiology of pre-eclampsia is diverse but mostly involves a mismatch between fetoplacental demands and uteroplacental supply, combined with a maternal predisposition to cardiometabolic disease. While our understanding of the mechanisms underlying pre-eclampsia has advanced in recent years, maternal and perinatal mortality remains high in low-income and middle-income countries (LMICs), where pre-eclampsia incidence is higher. Risk factors include maternal chronic hypertension, diabetes, obesity, and previous pre-eclampsia. Preventive strategies include structured behavioural changes focused on diet quality and moderate-intensity physical activity for women with metabolic risk factors, low-dose aspirin for women at high risk, and risk-stratified timed birth at term. To date, the only recourse for pre-eclampsia is delivery of the placenta, and many discrepancies in care remain between high-income countries and LMICs. Current efforts primarily focus on the prediction, accurate diagnosis, and prevention of pre-eclampsia.

articles.title: Rezpegaldesleukin treatment of moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis (REZOLVE-AD): final results from the 16-week induction period of an international, double-blind, placebo-controlled, randomised phase 2b study
articles.authors: Silverberg JI, Rosmarin D, Bieber T, Chovatiya R, Gooderham M, Gkalpakiotis S, Reich A, Murrell DF, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Rezpegaldesleukin is an interleukin-2 receptor agonist that selectively expands and enhances the function of regulatory T cells (Tregs), offering a novel therapeutic approach for autoimmune and inflammatory diseases such as atopic dermatitis. We aimed to compare the efficacy and safety analyses of rezpegaldesleukin with placebo in adults with moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis naive to biological treatments.
abstract.textZh: Rezpegaldesleukin是一種白介素-2受體激動劑，可選擇性地擴大和增強調節性T細胞（ Treg ）的功能，為自身免疫和炎症性疾病（如特應性皮炎）提供新的治療方法。我們旨在比較rezpegaldesleukin與安慰劑在中度至重度原發性特應性皮炎成人中的療效和安全性分析。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: REZOLVE-AD was a phase 2b, randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled study conducted in 107 community research centres or hospitals in ten countries (Australia, Bulgaria, Canada, Croatia, Czechia, Germany, Hungary, Poland, Spain, and the USA). Eligible patients were adults (aged 18 years or older) with confirmed atopic dermatitis (American Academy of Dermatology Consensus Criteria) diagnosed at least 12 months before enrolment, with moderate-to-severe disease activity defined by an Eczema Area and Severity Index (EASI) score of at least 16·0, validated Investigator Global Assessment for Atopic Dermatitis (vIGA-AD) score of at least 3 (moderate), and at least 10% affected body surface area. Patients were randomly allocated (3:3:3:2) to receive subcutaneous rezpegaldesleukin 24 μg/kg or rezpegaldesleukin 18 μg/kg every 2 weeks, rezpegaldesleukin 24 μg/kg every 4 weeks, or placebo for 16 weeks during the induction period. Randomisation was done by an independent vendor using Randomisation and Trial Supply Management methodology via an interactive response system and was stratified by baseline disease severity (vIGA-AD 3 [moderate] vs 4 [severe]) and geographical region (North America vs rest of world). All patients, investigators, and those assessing outcomes were masked to treatment assignment. Outcomes for the induction period were assessed through week 16 and are included in this report. The primary endpoint was percentage change from baseline in EASI score at week 16. Efficacy and safety analyses were conducted in all randomly assigned patients exposed to study treatment, excluding those enrolled at two sites closed due to Good Clinical Practice non-compliance, both of which received notification of closure approximately 300 days before database lock. All missing data were imputed with multiple imputation. The trial was registered with ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT06136741).

abstract.label: FINDINGS
abstract.text: 398 patients were enrolled between Nov 15, 2023, and Jan 9, 2025. A total of 393 patients were analysed (104 in the rezpegaldesleukin 24 μg/kg every 2 weeks group, 106 in the rezpegaldesleukin 18 μg/kg every 2 weeks group, 110 in the rezpegaldesleukin 24 μg/kg every 4 weeks group, and 73 in the placebo group); 203 (52%) patients were female and 190 (48%) were male. All three rezpegaldesleukin groups met the primary endpoint. Rezpegaldesleukin showed dose-dependent improvements compared with placebo in mean percentage change in EASI from baseline at week 16: -61% (SE 3·8) for rezpegaldesleukin 24 μg/kg every 2 weeks, -58% (3·8) for rezpegaldesleukin 18 μg/kg every 2 weeks, and -53% (3·7) for rezpegaldesleukin 24 μg/kg every 4 weeks versus -31% (4·5) for placebo. Treatment differences versus placebo were -30 percentage points (95% CI -41·3 to -18·0; p<0·0001) for rezpegaldesleukin 24 μg/kg every 2 weeks, -27 percentage points (-38·5 to -15·7; p<0·0001) for rezpegaldesleukin 18 μg/kg every 2 weeks, and -22 percentage points (-33·3 to -10·3; p=0·0002) for rezpegaldesleukin 24 μg/kg every 4 weeks. Treatment-emergent adverse events observed in at least 5% of rezpegaldesleukin-treated patients (n=320) and greater than placebo (n=73) included injection-site reaction (223 [70%] vs three [4%]), eosinophilia (25 [8%] vs two [3%]), pyrexia (20 [6%] vs two [3%]), headache (20 [6%] vs three [4%]), upper respiratory tract infections (19 [6%] vs four [5%]), and arthralgia (16 [5%] vs one [1%]). Nearly all (>99%) injection-site reactions were mild to moderate in severity and resolved. There was no evidence of an increased risk of serious or severe adverse events, and no deaths were reported during the induction period.

abstract.label: INTERPRETATION
abstract.text: Over the 16-week induction period, rezpegaldesleukin treatment resulted in significant and clinically meaningful improvements across multiple clinical endpoints, including the primary endpoint of EASI percentage change from baseline, in comparison with placebo. Rezpegaldesleukin had a clinically favourable adverse event profile in adult patients with moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis, supporting its further development as a novel Treg-enhancing biological treatment.

articles.title: Digital Outreach to Improve Statin Refills in Patients With Low Statin Adherence: The ADHERE-ASCVD Randomized Clinical Trial
articles.authors: Bhatt AS, Liu VX, Sun B, Apostol-Largeteau M, Marafino BJ, Amiri M, Tran DL, Ambrosy AP, et al.

abstract.label: IMPORTANCE
abstract.text: Statin nonadherence is a leading, addressable driver of preventable cardiovascular events. Although health systems routinely use outreach to promote preventive care, most strategies are static and lack evidence from randomized clinical trials.
abstract.textZh: 他汀類藥物不依從性是可預防心血管事件的主要、可解決的驅動因素。儘管衛生系統經常使用外展來促進預防性護理，但大多數策略都是靜態的，缺乏隨機臨牀試驗的證據。

abstract.label: OBJECTIVE
abstract.text: To determine whether an adaptive, sequential digital outreach strategy improves short-term statin refill vs usual communication among adults with established atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (ASCVD) or high ASCVD risk and recent nonadherence within a rapidly implemented, health system-embedded randomized clinical trial.
abstract.textZh: 在快速實施的衛生系統嵌入式隨機臨牀試驗中，確定適應性順序數位外展策略是否能改善已確診動脈粥樣硬化性心血管疾病（ ASCVD ）或高ASCVD風險和最近不依從的成年人之間的短期他汀類藥物補充與通常的溝通。

abstract.label: DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS
abstract.text: Pragmatic, health system-embedded, prospective randomized open blinded end point (PROBE) clinical trial using a 2-stage sequential, multiple assignment, randomized trial (SMART) design. The trial was conducted via Kaiser Permanente Northern California, an integrated health care delivery system serving more than 4.6 million members. Eligible participants were adults 18 years or older with established ASCVD or high ASCVD risk, recent statin nonadherence, and eligibility for all study communication modalities.
abstract.textZh: 採用2階段順序、多重指派、隨機試驗（ SMART ）設計的實用、衛生系統嵌入式、前瞻性隨機開放式盲法終點（ PROBE ）臨牀試驗。該試驗透過Kaiser Permanente Northern California進行，這是一個綜合醫療保健服務系統，服務超過460萬名會員。符合資格的參與者為年滿18歲且已建立ASCVD或ASCVD高風險、近期他汀類藥物不依從，以及符合所有研究溝通模式的資格的成年人。

abstract.label: INTERVENTIONS
abstract.text: Participants were randomized 1:1:1:1 to receive secure portal messaging, SMS/text messaging, nonsecure email, or usual communication. Initial nonresponders within 14 days underwent prespecified second-stage randomization to repeat the same outreach, switch communication modality, or receive usual communication.
abstract.textZh: 參與者被隨機分配1: 1: 1: 1 ，以接收安全的入口網站訊息、簡訊/簡訊、不安全的電子郵件或通常的通訊。14天內最初的無回應者進行了預先指定的第二階段隨機分組，以重複相同的外展、切換溝通方式或接受通常的溝通。

abstract.label: MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES
abstract.text: Rates of 14-day statin refill following each randomization, with 28-day follow-up.
abstract.textZh: 每次隨機分組後補充14天他汀類藥物的比率，並追蹤28天。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Among 20 604 participants (mean [SD] age, 54.8 [9.0] years; 40.9% female; 27.8% Asian, 10.9% Black, 33.6% Hispanic; 15.3% with established ASCVD), initial digital outreach increased 14-day statin refill vs usual communication (14.4% vs 12.0%; adjusted risk difference, 2.3 percentage points [95% CI, 1.3-3.4]; adjusted risk ratio, 1.20 [95% CI, 1.10-1.30]). Among initial nonresponders, second-stage outreach further increased refill (13.0% vs 10.4%; adjusted risk difference, 2.5 percentage points [95% CI, 1.3-3.7]; adjusted risk ratio, 1.25 [95% CI, 1.11-1.39]). Switching communication modalities did not improve refill vs repeating the same modality (13.2% vs 12.5%; adjusted risk ratio, 1.06 [95% CI, 0.94-1.17]). Cumulative statin refill through 28 days was higher in those receiving any digital outreach vs usual communication (24.9% vs 21.2%; adjusted hazard ratio, 1.21 [95% CI, 1.13-1.30]). Results were consistent across prespecified subgroups.
abstract.textZh: 在20 604名參與者中（平均[SD]年齡， 54.8 [9.0]歲； 40.9%女性； 27.8%亞裔， 10.9%黑人， 33.6%西班牙裔； 15.3%已建立ASCVD ） ，初始數位外展增加了14天他汀類藥物補充比平常溝通（ 14.4%對12.0% ；調整風險差異， 2.3個百分點[95% CI ， 1.3-3.4] ；調整風險比， 1.20 [95% CI ， 1.10-1.30] ）。在最初的無反應者中，第二階段外展進一步增加補充（ 13.0%對10.4% ；調整後的風險差異， 2.5個百分點[95% CI ， 1.3-3.7] ；調整後的風險比， 1.25 [95% CI ， 1.11-1.39] ）。與重複相同模式相比，切換通訊模式並未改善補充（ 13.2%對12.5% ；調整風險比， 1.06 [95% CI ， 0.94-1.17] ）。接受任何數位外展服務的受試者在28天內的累積他汀類藥物補充量高於日常通訊的受試者（ 24.9%對21.2% ；調整後的風險比， 1.21 [95% CI ， 1.13-1.30] ）。預先指定的次組之間的結果是一致的。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE
abstract.text: Among adults with a statin indication and recent statin nonadherence, adaptive outreach improved short-term refill vs usual communication. A second outreach produced additional gains among initial nonresponders, although switching communication modalities provided no additional benefit. These findings support adaptive, sequential health system outreach strategies to improve cardiovascular prevention when integrated into population health programs.

articles.authors: Roten L, Maurhofer J, Krisai P, Breitenstein A, Koepfli P, Saguner AM, Franzeck F, Pascale P, et al.

abstract.label: IMPORTANCE
abstract.text: Pulmonary vein isolation (PVI) is less effective in persistent than in paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (AF).

abstract.label: OBJECTIVE
abstract.text: To determine whether adding posterior left atrial wall isolation (PWI) to pulsed field ablation (PFA)-based PVI reduces atrial tachyarrhythmia in patients with persistent AF.

abstract.text: This investigator-initiated, multicenter, randomized superiority trial with blinded end-point adjudication was conducted at 6 centers in Switzerland. Patients with symptomatic, persistent AF were enrolled from November 2023 to February 2025, with 1-year follow-up completed February 2026.
abstract.textZh: 這項由試驗主持人發起的、多中心、隨機優效性試驗，採用盲法終點裁定，在瑞士的6個中心進行。自2023年11月至2025年2月，入組有症狀的持續性房顫患者，並於2026年2月完成1年隨訪。

abstract.text: The primary end point was first recurrence of atrial tachyarrhythmia during days 91 to 365 after ablation, detected by continuous ICM monitoring and adjudicated by an independent clinical events committee blinded to treatment allocation. There were 29 secondary end points, including atrial arrhythmia burden during days 91 to 365, time to arrhythmia recurrence during days 91 to 365 using different minimum episode durations, and a safety composite, which comprised cardiac tamponade requiring drainage, persistent phrenic nerve palsy lasting more than 24 hours, serious vascular complications requiring intervention, stroke or transient ischemic attack, atrioesophageal fistula, or death up to day 90.
abstract.textZh: 主要終點是消融後第91至365天首次復發房性心律失常，通過連續ICM監測檢測，並由對治療分配視而不見的獨立臨牀事件委員會裁定。有29個次要終點，包括第91至365天的房性心律失常負荷、使用不同最小發作持續時間的第91至365天的心律失常復發時間，以及包括需要引流的心臟填塞、持續性膈神經麻痺持續超過24小時、需要介入治療的嚴重血管併發症、中風或短暫性缺血發作、食道瘻或直到第90天的死亡的安全綜合治療。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Among 206 randomized patients (mean [SD] age, 65.8 [9.2] years; 165 [80.1%] males; 102 randomized to PVI with PWI; 104 randomized to PVI alone), atrial tachyarrhythmia recurred in 51 of 102 patients (50.6%) assigned to PVI with PWI and in 63 of 104 patients (60.6%) assigned to PVI alone (rate ratio [RR], 0.75 [95% CI, 0.51-1.09]; P = .13). Of the 29 prespecified secondary outcomes, 22 were not significantly different. The mean atrial arrhythmia burden was 6.9% and 11.0%, respectively (difference, -4.1 percentage points; 95% CI, -8.0 to -0.2 percentage points; P = .04). Across minimum episode durations of 1 hour or longer, 6 hours or longer, 1 day or longer, 2 days or longer, and 7 days or longer, RRs for PVI with PWI vs PVI alone were 0.64 (95% CI, 0.41-0.99), 0.62 (95% CI, 0.38-1.03), 0.37 (95% CI, 0.18-0.78), 0.40 (95% CI, 0.18-0.88), and 0.51 (95% CI, 0.22-1.23), respectively. The safety composite end point occurred in 2 patients assigned to PVI with PWI.
abstract.textZh: 在206名隨機分配的患者（平均[SD]年齡， 65.8 [9.2]歲； 165 [80.1%]男性； 102名隨機分配至PVI與PWI ； 104名隨機分配至PVI單獨）中，分配至PVI與PWI的102名患者中的51名（ 50.6% ）和104名患者中的63名（ 60.6% ）復發房性心律失常（比率[RR] ， 0.75 [95% CI ， 0.51-1.09] ； P = 0.13 ）。在29個預先指定的次要結果中， 22個沒有顯著差異。平均房性心律失常負荷分別為6.9%和11.0% （差異為-4.1個百分點； 95% CI為-8.0至-0.2個百分點； P = 0.04 ）。在1小時或更長時間、6小時或更長時間、1天或更長時間、2天或更長時間和7天或更長時間的最短發作期間， PVI與PWI相比，單獨PVI的RR分別為0.64 (95% CI ， 0.41-0.99)、0.62 (95% CI ， 0.38-1.03)、0.37 (95% CI ， 0.18-0.78)、0.40 (95% CI ， 0.18-0.88)和0.51 (95% CI ， 0.22-1.23)。安全綜合終點發生在2名被分配到PVI和PWI的患者中。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE
abstract.text: In patients with persistent AF, adding PFA-based PWI to PVI did not significantly reduce atrial tachyarrhythmia recurrence lasting 30 seconds or longer compared with PVI alone. The findings for secondary end points are hypothesis generating and warrant further evaluation in a larger trial.
